title: A number in motion
description: A spring-driven value that makes a change in quantity easy to follow.
useCase: Connect two values in a pricing calculator, progress readout or occasional metric update.
reducedMotion: The displayed value updates immediately to its target.
limitations: Do not announce every animation frame to assistive technology or animate a rapidly updating live feed.
look: Warm off-white page with a small olive-dot caption, a large dark tightly tracked tabular numeral, a thin rule and a small refresh icon button.
motion: Pressing the refresh button sets a new target and the figure counts to it through a Motion spring (stiffness 180, damping 26, mass 0.7), rounded and comma-formatted each frame.
adapt: The value is `useSpring` (`stiffness: 180, damping: 26, mass: 0.7`) mapped through `useTransform` and `numberFormat` into a `motion.span`; `spring.jump` skips the tween under reduced motion. Replace the `values` array and `setIndex` button with your metric source.
